# Part 1: Dealing with Large Numbers 

## 1a)

```{r}
# constructor function
pqnumber <- function(sign, p, q, nums) {
  if(sign != 1 && sign != -1) {
    stop("Sign needs to be either -1 or 1")
  } else if(p %% 1 != 0) {
    stop("p needs to be an integer")
  } else if(q %% 1 != 0) {
    stop("q needs to be an integer")
  } else if(length(nums) != (p + q + 1) || sum(nums %% 1 != 0)) {
    stop("nums vector needs to be length p+q+1 and all values in nums have to be between 1-8")
  }
  structure(list(sign, p, q, nums), class="pqnumber")
}

# predicate function
is_pqnumber <- function(x) {
  if(inherits(x, "pqnumber")) {
    return(TRUE)
  }
  return(FALSE)
}

# print() method
print.pqnumber <- function(x) {
  cat("Hello World!")
}

# coercion functions
as_pqnumber() <- function(x) {
  
}

```

```{r}
n1 <- pqnumber(1, 3, 4, c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8))
n2 <- pqnumber(1, 6, 0, c(3, 9, 5, 1, 4, 1, 3))
n3 <- pqnumber(-1, 5, 1, c(2, 8, 2, 8, 1, 7, 2))
is_pqnumber(n1)
is_pqnumber(1)
print(n1)
```
